Hi team,

Quick feasibility notes from pricing/solutions POV after a brief sync with infra/serving:

Option A — Dedicated small pool + quantized model (recommended):
- Dedicated 4-GPU pool pinned to an L2-optimized variant (40B q4)
- Expected P95: 35–45ms under their test profile if we enable prefix caching and keep sequence length at or below 128.
- Monthly uplift: +65% on top of usage baseline (reserved monthly commit).
- SLA credits: 5% credit per month for p95 breaches >2 days (proposal).

Option B — Regional routing + burst capacity (lower commitment):
- Shared pool with guaranteed capacity slices during business hours; fall back to hosted variant outside window.
- Expected P95: 50–75ms; lower price uplift (+30%).

Operational constraints / product asks:
- Need Product to accept a hard limit on supported prompt size (<=128 tokens) or degrade with documented latency profile.
- Require prefix/KV caching enabled for Octane’s most common prompt families — Product to provide an endpoint tag for caching.
- We should run a 2-week canary with 10% traffic to validate tails.

I attached a quick pricing/options sheet.

Attachment: SLA-options.xlsx

If Product/Infra agrees, I can prepare a two-column choice set for Octane and a pricing term to include in the MSA.

—Karthik
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

Hi Leila —

Thanks for the patience while we evaluated the ask. We can support a sub-50ms P95 commitment for your primary endpoint in US-west under the following agreed path:

- Commitment: sub-50ms P95 for single-turn generation (<=128 tokens) on the dedicated 4-GPU pool (L2-optimized, q4) for the US-west region.
- Operational plan: 2-week canary (10% traffic) followed by full cutover; rollback if P95 > 60ms for two consecutive business days.
- Governance: 30-day performance review clause; Octane must provide representative prompt families for caching and accept prefix-caching instrumentation.
- Commercials: 12-month minimum, monthly reserved commit (pricing uplift as shared). SLA and mutual action plan attached for signature.

Next steps:
1) Marissa/Karthik will send final MSA/SLA + DocuSign link (by EOD tomorrow).

3) We will schedule a 30-minute kickoff to iron out sweepers and monitoring dashboards.
